reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the redline is identical to the original text with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs (§1 Kubient Services and §5 Fees and Payment) contain no most-favoured-nation, 'no less favorable', or third-party-offer-matching obligation running against Customer; revenue share is simply set by Exhibit.

§1's express non-exclusivity language ('Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement... will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents') reinforces the absence of any MFN burden on Customer, matching the rule's preferred position.
No Vendor-granted MFN exists, but the rule does not require one, so the absence is correctly treated as immaterial rather than a deviation.
